- heading "Senior Software Engineer - SoC SW Productisation" [level=2]
- heading "Arm" [level=2]
- heading "Sophia Antipolis, France" [level=2]
- paragraph: Are you excited by solving complex system-level problems and ensuring sophisticated SoC platforms meet the quality standards required for production?
- paragraph: We are looking for a software test engineer in the Infrastructure Solutions Software team. This is a hands-on technical role focused on system-level validation and quality for our infrastructure platforms. You will develop test automation, investigate complex system issues and contribute to high-quality delivery across pre-silicon and silicon environments.
- paragraph: Come and make an impact at scale!
- heading "Responsibilities:" [level=3]
- heading "You will:" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: Develop and implement system-level validation across pre-silicon and silicon environments;
  - listitem: Develop test automation and infrastructure using appropriate tools, frameworks and programming languages;
  - listitem: Contribute to CI, regression and test infrastructure design and improvements;
  - listitem: Investigate and debug complex software, firmware and system-level issues;
  - listitem: Collaborate across software, firmware and hardware teams to resolve defects and support product readiness.
- heading "Required Skills and Experience:" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Strong experience in software testing and system-level validation for SoC, firmware, platform software or embedded systems;
  - listitem: Proficiency in Python and experience with C and/or C++;
  - listitem: Experience with Linux, system software, firmware or device drivers;
  - listitem: Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, including experience with software debugging tools;
  - listitem: Experience with CI, regression testing, test coverage and defect management.
- heading "“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience:" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Proficient working with Git;
  - listitem: Curious about open-source development practices;
  - listitem: Knowledgeable in computer architecture and microarchitecture concepts - ideally for the Arm architecture and its ecosystem;
  - listitem: Familiarity with the Linux kernel, Trusted Firmware-A (TF-A), UEFI EDK II, OpenBMC or Kernel-based Virtual Machine (KVM).
